title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI investigation of policy sync and device health (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The roadmap targets and the documented manual troubleshooting routes are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge published Endpoint DLP product licensing, cite the Worldwide roadmap item, and remove the unmatched role-assignment instruction from the checklist.

claims.claim: A policy that has not reached a device is not enforced there.
claims.quote: Policies that are updated while a device is offline won't be pushed to that device. Similarly, such policies won't be enforced on that device, until the device is back online. However, the outdated policy that exists on the offline device will still be enforced.
